'''Assimilated Wolves''', known internally as '''Infwolf''', are the [[Assimilated Mobs|Assimilated Version]] of Wolves.


== ''Spawning'' ==
* Spawned when a Wolf succumbs to [[Call Of The Hive|Call of The Hive]] below [[Evolution Phases#Phase 7|Phase 7]].
* Spawns in groups of 3 to 5, from [[Evolution Phases#Phase 2|Phase 2]] through [[Evolution Phases#Phase 7|Phase 7]], with a spawnweight of 25, once 2 Wolves have been assimilated.
* Spawned by [[Stage II Beckon|Stage II]] and [[Stage III Beckon|Stage III Beckons]].
* Spawned by [[Adapted Summoner]].
* Spawned by level 3 or higher [[Scent System|Scents]].

== ''Behavior'' ==
Assimilated Wolves are Melee Combatants.

* Their Melee Attack is performed through contact damage.
* Any Mob within 3 blocks of an Assimilated Wolf will be inflicted with COTH. This does not go through walls.
* Assimilated Wolves are able to traverse faster in liquids by performing small leaps.
* Assimilated Wolves are able to dive in liquids to pursue submerged targets.
* If an Assimilated Wolf gets 5 kills and is within range of a [[Moving Flesh]] or 3 other Assimilated Mobs<ref>Excluding [[Assimilated Ender Dragon]] and [[Assimilated Big Spider]].</ref>, it will evolve into a Moving Flesh.
* On death, Assimilated Wolves have a chance to explode, releasing [[Remains|Assimilated Remains]], 2 [[Buglin|Buglins]], and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]].
* Assimilated wolfes has 1% chance of spawning as a collar variant.
** When not exploding, there is a 50% chance an Assimilated Wolf will drop its [[Walking Wolf Head|Head]].

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===

* Assimilated Wolves, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
